source.citation: Artificial Analysis AutomationBench-AA; private v1.0.6 dataset (September 8, 2026)
source.description: 657 private SaaS workflows across six business domains. Models discover and call REST APIs across simulated apps with a 50-turn cap. Programmatic final-state grading awards the share of objectives completed, but any guardrail violation or error gives the task zero. Distinct from strict Tasks Completed, retained separately as the automationbench fallback.

source.citation: Surge AI GDP.pdf; independent Artificial Analysis implementation (September 8, 2026)
source.description: 100 professional document tasks across ten domains, five independent attempts per task. All-pass is the share of all 500 attempts satisfying every atomic criterion; errors and missing attempts score zero. AA supplies LiteParse document text to every model and rendered page images to image-capable models, so native vision is not required. Single-turn answers without tools; GPT-5.6 Luna medium criterion judge. AA harness and scores are separate from Surge results.

Anonymous human preference votes on multi-turn conversations. Fixed editorial rating anchors approximately 1428.8889–1600 place Grok 4.6's September 5 recorded rating of 1446 at 10 points. Bounds do not move with new results; ratings are not percentages. Agent Arena is a related collaboration fallback, not the same preference experiment.

Overall causal net improvement across five signals from real user sessions. Stored in percentage points relative to the comparison baseline, not task success percent. Fixed editorial -5 to +25 percentage-point anchors map linearly to 0–100 points; zero improvement maps to 16.67 points. Includes Praise vs Complaint, so weighting that separately introduces intentional overlap.

Separately weightable causal treatment effect for tasks where explicit praise outnumbers complaints. This is improvement relative to a baseline, not the percentage of users who praise a model. Fixed editorial -5 to +35 percentage-point anchors map linearly to 0–100 points; zero improvement maps to 12.5 points.

Full-task binary/strict completion on the authors' August 2026 full task release. Desktop and browser workflows with computer tools, including image input. Preserve harness differences in observations; never mix partial rewards, offline-only results, or June task files into this metric.
Verified real desktop and browser task success. Run-specific step limits, tools and evaluated task denominators remain in provenance. A shorter-workflow fallback for OSWorld 2.0.
